title: Essential Growth Stretches
summary: Remakes the animated guide demonstrating spine decompression stretches and inversion using 3D character motion, mint green vectors, and TallPlan branding.
style: Stylized 3D digital animation, smooth cartoon proportions, vibrant solid blue studio backdrop, soft studio lighting, clean wooden flooring.
character: Young 20-year-old male, athletic build, short dark textured hair, friendly stylized 3D face, wearing white crewneck t-shirt and black athletic shorts with white socks.
character_prompt: Stylized 3D cartoon young adult man, 20 years old, athletic slender build, short tousled black hair, wearing plain white fitted t-shirt and black shorts with white socks, standing relaxed in 3/4 view, clean blue studio background, soft 3D character render, no text.

keyframes.name: standing_base
keyframes.prompt: Full body stylized 3D young adult male in white t-shirt and black shorts standing upright against vivid blue background, confident posture.

keyframes.name: cobra_stretch
keyframes.prompt: Full body stylized 3D young adult male performing cobra stretch on polished wood floor, palms flat, chest arched upward, blue background.

keyframes.name: hanging_bar
keyframes.prompt: Full body stylized 3D young adult male hanging with both arms extended overhead from a horizontal bar, legs dangling straight, solid blue backdrop.

shots.vo: To unlock your full height, these four stretches are essential.
visuals: Studio blue backdrop, quick camera push-in on character standing upright as glowing mint green vertical arrow surges up beside him. SFX: Upward whoosh.
Smooth transition to floor; character drops into prone position and pushes chest upward into cobra stretch. SFX: Floor slide swish.

shots.vo: First is the cobra stretch, decompressing your lower spine.
visuals: Behind character low angle, spine visibly illuminated with internal mint green energy pulsing toward the neck. SFX: Shimmering hum.
Fast whip pan up to character grabbing overhead bar, lifting feet off floor. SFX: Quick whoosh.

shots.vo: Next, dead hangs instantly relieve spinal compression.
visuals: Full shot hanging straight down, subtle downward mint green force arrows along spine and legs. SFX: Low tension stretch sound.
Quick switch to hanging from top of modern door frame, body suspended straight. SFX: Solid grip thud.

shots.vo: Third, an inversion table fully reverses gravity's daily pull.
visuals: Side view of character strapped onto black inversion bench, camera pans as table tilts backwards. SFX: Mechanical pivot click.
Full inversion upside down, mint green decompression arrows extending down from ankles to head. SFX: Riser whoosh.

shots.vo: And track your customized height growth journey in TallPlan.
visuals: Character dismounts into standing stance, standing tall with shoulders back and smiling. SFX: Confident step thud.
Character positioned in lower third of frame looking upward, upper half open for card overlay, mint green aura glowing. SFX: Pop chime.

voice: Young adult male, North American accent, crisp upbeat explainer tone, ~145 WPM, clean studio narration
